svg.aria-label: Agent core: customer UI and mock OIDC identity service → AgentCore Runtime hosting a LangGraph workflow (load_context, understand, route, dispute chain with confirm interrupt, clarify, handoff, reply) → Claude on Bedrock, Jev on TypeSafe, S3 serving parquet via DuckDB, DynamoDB, OpenTelemetry. Animated: a dispute filed after confirmation, then an unauthorized-charge report handed off to a human.
svg.text: app.py · re-verify JWT → SessionContext (customer_id from token only) → graph.invoke
DynamoDBSaver checkpointer · edges chosen by code, never by an LLM
code gates on every path: token scope · ownership (not_found ≡ not owned) · dispute_policy.yaml
Claude has no tools · Jev can only pick among edges the graph already allows
Bedrock · S3 · DynamoDB via IAM role
① «Me cobraron dos veces Netflix, quiero disputarlo» → Bearer JWT → AgentCore → re-verified
load_context: this customer's products + 60-day transactions (DuckDB over S3 parquet)
understand: Claude extract + gloss → one Jev call: intent=dispute_charge · target=c7 · reason=duplicate
route → resolve_transaction → check_eligibility: Approved · ≤ 60 d · ≤ USD 500 · not already disputed
⏸ confirm: fixed ES summary, graph pauses; next message → Jev confirmation = confirm ≥ 0.90
file_dispute: conditional put (PK transaction_id) → verify: consistent read-back = receipt
reply: Claude composes from receipts → Jev verify_reply → «Disputa DSP-… registrada»
② «No reconozco este cargo, alguien usó mi tarjeta» → Jev reports_unauthorized_use ≥ 0.50
handoff: code builds handoff.v1 (verified facts · actions · decisions · open questions) → human queue
